module_summary: I2C slave bridging to AXI-Stream: filtered SCL/SDA edge and start/stop detection drive an 8-state FSM that shifts bytes through a data register with clock stretching.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/ADDRESS/ACK/WRITE/READ FSM sequencing I2C bits and AXI transfers

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Shift register for address/data bits in and out of SDA

anchors.name: m_axis_data_tdata
anchors.why: Bytes written over I2C, output on AXI stream

anchors.name: m_axis_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Output byte valid; stalls write via clock stretching when not accepted

anchors.name: s_axis_data_tready
anchors.why: Ready to accept byte for I2C read transfer

anchors.name: sda_o
anchors.why: SDA open-drain output for ACK and read data bits

anchors.name: scl_o
anchors.why: SCL output held low for clock stretching

anchors.name: bit_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts bits of address/data byte, ends shift phases

anchors.name: start_bit
anchors.why: START condition detect restarting FSM at ADDRESS

anchors.name: stop_bit
anchors.why: STOP condition detect returning FSM to IDLE

anchors.name: mode_read_reg
anchors.why: Latched R/W bit choosing read or write path after ACK

anchors.name: s_axis_data_tdata
anchors.why: Byte supplied for I2C read, loaded into data_reg

anchors.name: s_axis_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Input byte valid for read transfer

anchors.name: m_axis_data_tready
anchors.why: Downstream accepts output byte; clears tvalid

anchors.name: m_axis_data_tlast
anchors.why: Marks last byte of write at start/stop

anchors.name: scl_posedge
anchors.why: SCL rising edge strobe sampling SDA bits

anchors.name: scl_negedge
anchors.why: SCL falling edge strobe driving SDA changes

anchors.name: data_valid_reg
anchors.why: data_reg holds a full byte; gates read shift and output store

anchors.name: data_out_reg_valid_reg
anchors.why: Delayed write byte pending, released to tvalid when next byte arrives

anchors.name: sda_i_reg
anchors.why: Glitch-filtered SDA input sampled into data_reg

anchors.name: scl_i_filter
anchors.why: Shift-register glitch filter for SCL input

anchors.name: release_bus
anchors.why: Host command forcing FSM back to IDLE

anchors.name: device_address
anchors.why: Slave address compared against received address

anchors.name: device_address_mask
anchors.why: Mask selecting address bits to compare

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Enables responding to address match

anchors.name: bus_address
anchors.why: Matched bus address latched in addr_reg

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: FSM not idle indication

anchors.name: bus_active
anchors.why: Bus active between start and stop

anchors.name: bus_addressed
anchors.why: Module currently addressed on bus

groups.name: I2C slave FSM
groups.description: Sequences address, ACK, write and read byte phases

groups.name: Bit shift datapath
groups.description: Shifts SDA bits in/out of data_reg and drives SDA/SCL with stretching

groups.name: Bus condition detector
groups.description: Filters SCL/SDA and detects edges, START and STOP

groups.name: AXI-Stream ports
groups.description: Registered AXI stream input and output byte interfaces

groups.name: Address match and status
groups.description: Address compare configuration and bus status reporting
